biggest_catch: Limited-time offer: new customer must open the Woodforest personal checking account by September 30, 2026; accounts opened online do not qualify; rewards can be credited through December 29, 2026.
catches: New friend must open the checking account in-branch by 9/30/2026; online-opened accounts do not qualify.
Referrer eligibility begins 35 days after the referrer's own account opening.
$5 of the $25 is credited on day 35; the remaining $20 only after all qualifying activities post within 90 days of account opening.
Referral rewards not deposited to accounts closed or restricted at posting time.
Employees of Woodforest are not eligible.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: Woodforest National Bank's official Refer-A-Friend referral form (woodforest.bank, rev 6/25/26) offers Referral Rewards to referring customers.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referring customer earns $25 per qualifying referral ($5 credited on day 35 plus $20 when all qualifying activities are met), capped at up to 4 referrals ($100) per calendar year.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: referrer completes the referral form with their information; the friend presents the completed form in-branch when opening a new Woodforest personal checking account; the friend keeps the account open at least 35 days (earning the $5 portion) and completes all qualifying activities within 90 days of account opening (earning the $20 portion).

c4.evidence: Timing: the $5 reward is credited on day 35 after account opening; the $20 reward is credited on the day all qualifying activities are met.

eligibility: Referrer: current Woodforest personal checking account holders (eligibility begins 35 days after account opening). Friend: new Woodforest customers opening a personal checking account in-branch with the referral form.
notes: Rewards may be reportable as miscellaneous or interest income on Form 1099-MISC or 1099-INT.
payout_quote: Referring customers can receive up to four (4) Refer a Friend Rewards (potentially $25 per referral, totaling $100) per calendar year.
payout_value_note: Cash credits to the referrer's Woodforest account, not a gift card.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: No cost to refer; a paper referral form is completed by the referrer and presented by the friend in-branch.

s3.note: Referral rewards may be reportable to the IRS on Form 1099-MISC or Form 1099-INT.

s4.note: Cap: up to 4 referrals ($100 total) per calendar year.

s5.note: Offer live on the current official form (rev 6/25/26, observed 2026-09-23); new accounts must be opened by 9/30/2026; rewards can be credited through 12/29/2026.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official form: referrer completes the form; friend presents it in-branch when opening the new personal checking account.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: keep the new checking account open at least 35 days ($5 tier); within 90 days of opening: account open/active 35 days, average positive ledger balance, at least 3 qualifying deposits, at least 15 qualifying debit card purchases ($20 tier).

steps: Complete the official Woodforest referral form with your information.
Have your friend visit a branch and present the completed form while opening their new Woodforest personal checking account.
Friend keeps the account open 35 days (you earn $5) and completes all qualifying activities within 90 days (you earn $20), for a total of $25 per qualifying referral.
timing: $5 credited on day 35 after account opening; $20 credited the day all qualifying activities are met.
when_cash_arrives: $5 credits on day 35 after account opening; the remaining $20 only when all qualifying activities are met. Accounts must be opened in-branch (online openings do not qualify).
maximize: Only $5 is fast (day 35); the other $20 waits on full qualification.
The account must be opened in-branch - online openings are excluded from this offer.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: split payout with a 35-day floor on even the first $5, plus an in-branch requirement.
